name: Response type
description: What the public should do, using the same codes as CAP 1.2 (OASIS). This is separate from the free-text instruction so a system can act on it automatically — a phone can override silent mode for 'evacuate' but not for 'monitor'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Shelter
hasDefinedTerm.description: Take shelter now, or as instructed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Execute
hasDefinedTerm.description: Carry out a plan you already have in place.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Avoid
hasDefinedTerm.description: Stay away from the hazard or the area.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Assess
hasDefinedTerm.description: Evaluate the situation. Meant for responders, not the public.
